description: This source file defines an interface for a cache with expiring values, supporting put operations with expiration times and retrieving values considering their expiry.

classes.name: ExpiringValueCache
classes.description: An interface for a cache that stores values with expiration times, supporting insertion and retrieval operations.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a value in the cache with a specific expiration time or duration, replacing any existing value for the given key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with the given key if it exists and is not expired; otherwise, returns null.
